strings: The Great Tree Provides is a quest in Dolanaar where Byancie enlists aid to halt a dangerous affliction threatening Eralya. By harvesting dewy lasher fronds from Teldrassil's lakes and gathering basic supplies, players help prepare an urgent restorative salve.

In the forested village of Dolanaar, Byancie tends to the well-being of the local night elves. When news arrives that Eralya has fallen victim to a dangerous affliction out in the wilds of Teldrassil, Byancie immediately sets to work preparing an emergency treatment. Without a quick-acting salve to halt the progression of the ailment, Eralya will not survive the journey back to the village for formal care.

Even in moments of crisis, the kaldorei put their trust in the bounty of Teldrassil. Byancie turns to the living world tree for the cure, seeking dewy lasher fronds known to flourish near Lake Al'Ameth to the south and Wellspring Lake to the northwest. Blended with clean spring water in a simple glass vial, these potent leaves provide the vital medicine needed to hold the affliction at bay.
